'''Ema Slake''' was a [[Color/Legends|copper]]-skinned [[Albingi]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Oseon 5631]], known throughout the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] for her massive [[Music/Legends|music]] collection, which was said to contain over twenty-five percent of the known music in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="THH" />
